verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas ships an official Editor MCP server that lets connected AI assistants read and modify project data and verify results in the viewport, which could be used to generate suggestions/insights from a user's scene data, but there is no evidence of a native, built-in AI insights/recommendations feature (e.g., analytics, optimization suggestions) inside the product itself. Missing for 10: dedicated AI-insights UI or documented use-case of the MCP server producing analytical suggestions, independent corroboration of this workflow in practice.
